reviews_captured_by_me.text:
In November 2017 Frank refinished my old 1952 yo tub.  He did a beautiful job.  Now 8 years later the tub needed a minor repair.  Frank did the repair and I asked if he would return to remove the tape. He did.  Frank is a good guy and I highly recommend him and his work.  Life is all about you treat people and Frank is good guy!
Thank you Frank.

Frank is a stand up guy. Professional, knowledgeable and prompt. Showed up to give us an estimate on time. The price was extremely reasonable. We set up an appointment and he was here as promised, finished the job in about 2 hours. And Wow!
Our old rusted, peeling nasty tub came out like new! This guy did magic. He knows his craft and does it well. I have another job for him in the near future. Highly recommend.

B&J Services refinished my kitchen sink November 2019.  B&J has returned three times to repair the applied finish as it has peeled each time at the drain flange.  B&J Services is now claiming a drain rack has voided the warranty.  As you can see from the photo it is clearly a re-finish failure.
